def compute_power(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

import sys

MOD = 1000000007

for line in sys.stdin:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    p_str, k_str = line.strip().split()
    p, k = int(p_str), int(k_str)
    if k == 0:
        print(compute_power(p, p - 1, MOD))
        continue
    if k == 1:
        print(compute_power(p, p, MOD))
        continue
    cycle_count = 0
    val = 1
    while True:
        next_val = (k * val) % p
        val = next_val
        cycle_count += 1
        if next_val == 1:
            break
    print(compute_power(p, (p - 1) // cycle_count, MOD))
